success.description: As above, and you have to internalize the laws. If you are about to break a law, the GM must warn you that you can choose to do something else.

conservative.requirements: 8 favour, be within jurisdiction. To invoke this blessing, you must have a complete listing of all the laws of the target jurisdiction in written format and must read all of it. Special: The difficulty is dependent on the scope and size of the target jurisdiction: Small hamlet Easy (1Df); Modest village (2Df); Sizable town (3Df); Average town - city (4Df); Whole city - state such as Altdorf (5Df). Effect: Verena casts her eye down and enforces the law. Anyone who breaks any law within the jurisdiction immediately suffers 1 fatigue and 1 stress, regardless of whether they are observed or prosecuted.
conservative.name: Enforce the Law

success.description: As above, and you can spot the characteristic flinch of a lawbreaker suffering Verena’s punishment. You know if anyone in your line of sight suffers the penalty of this blessing.
